candidate_query:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.211'})
RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber, ti.impactType AS impactType
ORDER BY impactType ASC, trNumber ASC

MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact {impactType: 'NewTS'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(sp:Spec)
RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber, sp.specNumber AS specNumber, ti.impactType AS impactType
ORDER BY impactType ASC, trNumber ASC

MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'})
MATCH (cr)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting)
WITH DISTINCT cr, m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt,
  CASE WHEN m.meetingNumber =~ 'RAN1#[0-9]+b(-e)?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS meetingBisOrdinal
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, meetingNumberInt, meetingBisOrdinal, cr.crNumber AS crNumber
ORDER BY meetingNumberInt DESC, meetingBisOrdinal DESC, crNumber ASC
